name: Eliphaz
overview: Eliphaz is a male figure identified as the Temanite and a friend of Job, as noted in Job 2:11. There is no record of his tribal affiliation or additional personal details. His role is primarily connected to his relationship with Job during the trials described in the Book of Job.
namesAndTitles: The name Eliphaz means 'G-d is fine gold' or 'G-d crushes,' reflecting a theologically rich meaning connected to God (El). This proper name highlights a divine association but was not given directly by God according to the biblical record.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for Eliphaz beyond his designation as a friend of Job. There are no additional relational details provided in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Eliphaz holds significance in the biblical narrative as one of Job's friends who engages with him during his period of suffering. His identity as the Temanite places him within a broader cultural context known for wisdom. Eliphaz's interactions with Job contribute to the theological discussions about suffering and divine justice in the Book of Job.
